notes.1.206: Line 206: ḏr.kwj, 'overcome', is uncertain. Line 209: 'hidden' is not in the text, which has only wn.t 'that was'; the bracket marks a supplied word. Line 211: šm and sḫn are kinds of spell or rite, otherwise uncertain; snḥꜣ, rendered 'made ineffective', is uncertain; the line has a gap.

nodes.text: I am overcome because of it.
Would that I had raised my voice at that moment, that it might have saved me from the pain I am in!
Indeed, the sacred [chamber]: its writings are removed.
The place of secrets that was [hidden] is laid bare.
*Šm*-spells and *sḫn*-spells are made ineffective through being remembered [...] [...] by people.
Indeed, the offices are open, their records removed.
Serfs have become lords of serfs.
